items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: The interviewee names his alligator 'Pete' after Pete Fountain, and mentions Pete Fountain in the context of Mardi Gras, but does not describe a personal interaction, collaboration, or friendship with the musician himself.

ctx.x: He even took his alligator in the ballroom. You took your alligator in the ballroom? Yeah, Pete. I had an alligator. Who did you name your alligator after?

Pete. Yeah, I named him Pete. I had a duck before the jets come out. Before the jet plane come out, I had a duck born just like a jet. Oh, yeah? And the collector wanted to buy that duck. He come home, he wanted to give my wife $10 for it. Right where I'm staying there in the yard. That duck would walk around here just like a jet. Then them jet planes come out. And he wanted to give it $10 for it and we wouldn't sell it to him. He got it to next corner. The dog broke the duck neck. I couldn't do nothing for him…
